Repeat for more drama but remember less is more. A tiny amount goes a long way. Applying too much can create texture and waste product.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Don’t apply directly from the jar.
settings.text: Don’t apply directly from the jar.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Spread a tiny amount onto the back of …
settings.text: Spread a tiny amount onto the back of your hand first, then press a thin layer onto the skin. This gives you better control, smoother application, and the perfect amount of product every time.

settings.text: Mist your finished makeup with FORPLAY® Pre-Glitter Waterproof Mist before applying SPACEPASTE®. It creates the perfect base for long-lasting, waterproof wear.

settings.repere: Intertitre · HOW TO REMOVE
settings.text: HOW TO REMOVE

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Removing SPACEPASTE® is easier than yo…
settings.text: Removing SPACEPASTE® is easier than you think. The secret is to lift, not scrub.

settings.repere: Point · Hold a damp makeup wipe, cotton round …
settings.text: Hold a damp makeup wipe, cotton round with micellar water, or a damp sponge over the glitter for a few seconds.

settings.repere: Point · Gently wipe in one direction to lift t…
settings.text: Gently wipe in one direction to lift the glitter away.

settings.repere: Point · Fold to a clean section and repeat as …
settings.text: Fold to a clean section and repeat as needed.

settings.repere: Point · Wash away any remaining sparkle with y…
settings.text: Wash away any remaining sparkle with your normal cleanser.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Avoid rubbing back and forth. That can…
settings.text: Avoid rubbing back and forth. That can spread glitter around and increase the chance of getting it into your eyes.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Pro Tip: Need a quick fix? Clear tape …
settings.text: Pro Tip: Need a quick fix? Clear tape or a lint roller easily lifts away any stubborn glitter without the mess.
